measurement.precision: fp32; baseline and floor re-measured in-run per model per resolution

design_notes.part_A: random heads drawn from outside the stage C top-D_TOP with a per-model seed; regenerator ranks 1 and 2 knocked out separately because the gap between them is 0.7 SD on naver and has no measured noise scale on the other models
design_notes.part_B: image term from cached per-image similarity matrices, gated against the repo's own SSDC; seed term from four RPI permutation seeds; blocks are the probe layer and 11
design_notes.anchors: checked at 1000 images against W5 before the 5000-image sweep, because a different sample size gives a different point estimate
design_notes.excluded: rope_ape from part A (head knockouts cost ~0 top-1 in W5, APE carries position at the probe layer); DINOv3 from part A (num_classes = 0)
